events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $6.82 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
The trip was a RydeTAXI metered ride, charged $44.27 with distance $30.41 over 21.6 km [F6], against an optimal route of 16.6 km [F1]. Because RydeTAXI bills by the meter, extra kilometres feed directly into the fare, so RD-2's metered branch applies rather than the flat-fare branch [F1][F6][RD-2]. The GPS record shows one off-route segment, 21:56–22:03, of 4.84 km where the optimal route covers 0.00 km [F3], which RD-1 treats as a deviation requiring a justification [F3][RD-1].

The driver's accident excuse does not qualify under RD-4(a): the only incident on the optimal route, a 21:57 accident on the Ayer Rajah Expressway [F12], was reported at 21:57, i.e. after the segment began at 21:56 [F3], so it cannot have caused the deviation, and the speed-band records for AYE (band 5) and CTE (band 4) are merely corroborative and cannot exempt on their own [F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. The weather was fair, removing any other "reasonable cause" [F13][RD-4].

No consent exists: the chat contains only pickup logistics [F7][F8], so there is no driver route proposal made before leaving the optimal route with a rider's agreement; RD-5 is therefore not satisfied [F7][F8][RD-5]. Nor is this a rider-named stop, as nothing in the chat shows the rider asked for any stop [F7][F8][RD-3]. The segment is thus a non-exempt off-route segment [F3][RD-1].

The refund is the segment's extra distance at the trip's per-kilometre rate: distance fare $30.41 ÷ 21.6 km = $1.4098/km (as computed in the trace from [F6] and [F1]); 4.84 km × $1.4098/km = $6.8234, rounded to $6.82 [F3][F6][RD-2]. This is less than the billed excess of $7.03 [F4] because the mapping residual outside the segment is not refunded [F4][RD-2]. RD-6 does not add an account flag: the driver's route-dispute upheld count in the last 90 days is 0 [F15][RD-6].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news: we reviewed your RydeTAXI trip and you're getting $6.82 back, issued as a Ryde voucher. You were billed $44.27 on the meter, and the distance charged covered 21.6 km while the best route is 16.6 km. We found one stretch of the trip where you went off the best route with no valid reason — no accident could explain it, the weather was fine, and no one asked for a stop or agreed to a different route. We're refunding the extra distance from that stretch only, so it's less than the full difference. Nothing else changes on your account.

DRIVER: We reviewed the route-dispute on your RydeTAXI trip and are refunding the rider $6.82 as a Ryde voucher, deducted from your earnings. The meter billed 21.6 km against a 16.6 km best route, and one stretch of your trip went off the best route. Your accident explanation didn't hold: the reported incident came after that stretch began, and the traffic-band records alone can't exempt a deviation on their own. We also found no rider agreement to the route and no requested stop. This is a refund only — no account flag.
